conditions.geometry: NASA TMR sharp-edge NACA 0012; original formula extended to x=1.008930411365 and rescaled to unit chord

cfd.note: Published reference CFD, not computed here or experimental truth. First and second contour branches retained in full. At alpha zero the two sides nearly overlap. Source warns of high numerical error very near the trailing edge; no grid-uncertainty bound is supplied.

panel.note: Actual current Wing Lab incompressible panel solve on the NASA geometry. No skin friction; pressure-drag residual is not total drag.

machine.note: Fresh upstream ADAPT prediction on the NASA geometry. Re=6e6 is comparison context only, not a model input.

scope: Three numerical models, not experimental validation. CFD and ADAPT use M=.15; panel is incompressible. Same NASA section definition with different numerical geometry representations.
